reason: I eat out most days because a plate is 50-60 baht, and when I do cook my mum already sends me recipes on LINE for free. I might try the free beta dishes, but paying 99 baht for 12 more dishes I probably won't cook is two street-food meals gone.
objection: I barely cook, so I'd use the free 5 dishes once or twice and forget it. Pre-ordering by PromptPay for something not out yet feels like paying for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: If the free dishes actually got me cooking cheaper than street food every week, like the 40 baht a meal plan really working for a student alone, then 99 baht for more dishes would make sense.
